title: Global weak normalization implies strong normalization in pure type systems
exact_target: For every pure type system with arbitrary sorts, axioms and rules, if every legal expression in every valid context has some terminating $\beta$-reduction sequence, must every $\beta$-reduction sequence of each such expression terminate? Reduction includes type annotations and the specification need not be functional.
